results.title: New Zealand 2026 World Cup Preview: Ready to Enjoy the Ride of a Lifetime
highlights:
## New Zealand’s Predicted Starting XI
[...]
Wood missed much of the 2025–26 Premier League season because of a knee injury that required surgery, and sat out the most recent international games in March. The veteran striker and national team legend is closing on 50 goals scored for his country. But the question of who can support his output, especially if at the age of 34 he’s struggling physically, remains.
[...]
Typical starters Sarpreet Singh, Matthew Garbett and Liberato Cacace have also been injured in 2026. The likes of Ben Old and Jesse Randall, left back Francis de Vries and 36-year-old frontman Kosta Barbarouses will step in to provide the creativity accordingly.

[...]
New Zealand are the clear underdogs of Group G and will struggle against Belgium, Egypt, and Iran on paper. The most likely outcome is a group-stage exit. But the All Whites’ organization and Chris Wood’s quality make them dangerous in a one-off match, and the expanded format means a single famous result could keep their hopes flickering. A first-ever World Cup win — perhaps against Egypt or Iran — is the realistic dream. Recapturing the unbeaten spirit of 2010 would be the fairy-tale ceiling.

results.title: Iran vs New Zealand Lineups, Starting 11, Bench & Formation | FWC Times
highlights:
Iran vs New Zealand lineups are yet to be confirmed for Group G Match 16 at the FIFA World Cup 2026. The IR Iran national football team and New Zealand men’s national football team meet on June 15, 2026, at Los Angeles Stadium, with kickoff at 21:00 ET. This projected lineup tracker covers the starting XI, formations, bench options, managers, and late matchday updates. This Iran national football team vs New Zealand national football team lineups tracker stays projected until official match sheets arrive.
[...]
Iran have named a 30-player preliminary squad under Amir Ghalenoei, with Mehdi Taremi and Alireza Jahanbakhsh included and Sardar Azmoun outside the current group. New Zealand have named a 26-man squad under Darren Bazeley, with Chris Wood captaining the All Whites. Official matchday lineups remain projected until both teams release their sheets.
[...]
New Zealand’s 26-man list gives Bazeley a settled tournament base. OFC confirmed Chris Wood as captain and listed a group with Crocombe, Boxall, Cacace, Bell, Stamenic, Singh, Barbarouses, Old, and Waine. The squad includes all 11 starters from the qualifying win over New Caledonia.
[...]
The official Iran vs New Zealand lineups are not confirmed yet. The projected card uses squad announcements, current player roles, manager patterns, and tactical fit. Iran are projected in a 4-2-3-1, while New Zealand are projected in a 4-3-3.
[...]
## New Zealand Starting XI
[...]
The New Zealand national team starting XI is also yet to be confirmed. Bazeley’s projected 4-3-3 starts with Crocombe behind Payne, Boxall, Pijnaker, and Cacace. Bell can anchor midfield, with Stamenic and Singh giving the side running and passing range.
[...]
Barbarouses and Old can work wide of Wood, who remains New Zealand’s key penalty-box target. Wood’s hold-up play gives the All Whites their best route out of pressure. If Iran dominate the ball, New Zealand need those wide outlets to keep counters alive.
[...]
The projected Iran vs New Zealand lineups revolve around Mehdi Taremi and Chris Wood. Taremi gives Iran finishing, link play, and tournament experience. Wood gives New Zealand a clear captain, target forward, and aerial route.
[...]
New Zealand’s official lineup is yet to be confirmed. The projected XI follows Darren Bazeley’s 26-man squad and recent All Whites selection pattern.
